evidence.quote: This is the spirit in which I will discuss the paper--not as a comment on the current stance of policy, but as an exploration of the factors that should be taken into account
I think they are absolutely on target in emphasizing that the rapid growth of fixed-income funds--as well as other, similar vehicles--bears careful watching.
So monetary policymakers cannot wash their hands of what happens when these spreads revert sharply.
I would not want to rule out the possibility that some of the risks identified by the authors could be mitigated, at least in part, via a regulatory approach.
